_note: Checking the empty shipping bin: a note from Tsuru, the village head, tied to the lid. The first time it asks one question; the flag bin_note_read makes later checks short. Format: README.md, Dialogue.

lines.speaker: farmer
lines.text: Nothing to ship yet. Oh, there's a folded note tucked under the straw rope on the lid.

lines.speaker: tsuru
lines.text: Welcome to the valley! Put your crops in this bin before six in the evening. The cart from town takes them and leaves the money with me for you.

lines.speaker: tsuru
lines.text: Shall I write your name on the lid, so the cart driver knows whose bin this is?

lines.speaker: tsuru
lines.text: Then I'll bring my brush next time I walk past. Work hard, and rest when the sun goes down. - Tsuru

lines.speaker: tsuru
lines.text: No hurry. Tell me when you've settled in. And don't skip meals! - Tsuru

lines.speaker: farmer
lines.text: Nothing to ship yet. Tsuru's note is still tucked under the rope.
